messages:
sara: seeing a big spike of 504/gateway timeouts for hosted-api (customer: acme-prod). started ~12:03 UTC, last 7m. throughput fine but queue depth skyrocketed. many requests hitting /v1/generate return 504s.
alex: ack. looking at ingress queue and scaler metrics now. any repro request IDs?
sara: forwarded a sample request id in thread — rId: a1b2c3. also seeing increase in Pod Pending -> ContainerCreating.
jin: checked k8s: multiple replicas in Pod Pending stuck at init-container step 'fetch-model'. init logs show repeated 403 from model-store: "error fetching weights: 403 Unauthorized". suspect token fetch failure.
mike: ops-bot shows KEDA ScaledObject for model-server: minReplicaCount: 0, cooldownPeriod: 300, pollingInterval: 30. HPA target CPU scaled too late. With min 0 -> coldstart required.
alex: so two problems: (1) minReplicas 0 => coldstarts, (2) model fetch failing due to auth -> init containers never finish => pods stuck, scaler doesn't help.
linda: customer-facing support reports timeouts and high latency. we've already escalated to SLT. Need quick mitigation to reduce customer impact.
jin: reproducing init failure logs:
```
[init] fetching model from s3://models/acme/2026-03-15
[init] request token from model-auth: POST /token -> got 429 from auth-service
[init] retry -> 403 Unauthorized
failed to fetch model: 403 Unauthorized
```
mike: auth-service graph shows spike in token service latencies and 429 rate-limit responses tied to billing token-check service. billing-svc had a transient throttle at 12:01 UTC while processing usage bursts (linked incident #billing-332).
alex: propose immediate mitigations:
- patch ScaledObject/HPA to minReplicaCount: 2 for the model-server pool
- reduce cooldownPeriod to 60s and pollingInterval to 10s
- add temporary model-cache sidecar on existing warm nodes (if possible)
- fallback route to quantized smaller model for acme-prod to reduce init size
can we apply HPA patch now?
sara: please do, customers are actively affected.
jin: kubectl patch commands to run now:
```
kubectl -n inference patch scaledobject model-server --type='merge' -p '{"spec": {"minReplicaCount": 2, "cooldownPeriod": 60, "pollingInterval": 10}}'
kubectl -n inference patch hpa model-server --type='merge' -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 2}}'
```
alex: applying now.
deploy-bot: scaledobject/model-server updated by alex at 12:10 UTC
deploy-bot: hpa/model-server updated by alex at 12:10 UTC
jin: changes applied. KEDA polling triggered additional pods but some pods still failing init due to auth 403. need immediate auth workaround.
alex: gate change: temporarily bypass token verification for model-fetch within internal VPC for model-store while billing token-service recovers. ops, can you open a short allowlist?
mike: adding an exception to model-store auth for service-account=init-puller for 10m. patching auth-nginx allowlist.
mike: allowlist applied. init containers now proceed and pods reach Ready.
sara: confirming: traffic to acme-prod returns 200s again and 504s dropping off.
linda: notifying account exec and support owners. will request a postmortem and follow-up with billing team about throttle alignment.
alex: follow-ups (action items):
- platform: set minReplicaCount default for model pools to 1 or 2 for critical customers (jin)
- infra: add circuit-breaker between model-auth and billing checks to avoid auth cascade (mike)
- product: add fallback routing per-account to lighter model variant (sara)
- eng: add runbook steps to warm a small cache during burst for hosted inference (alex)
jin: I'll open an incident doc and attach relevant logs + k8s diffs. putting CR on changelog to avoid minReplica=0 for prioritized pools.
linda: customer update drafted and sent. marking incident as mitigated; monitoring for 30m.
alex: closing note: root cause = combination of scaler config (min=0 & long cooldown) + auth/billing token throttling causing init failures. cascade amplified by large model fetch size. will follow up with RCA.
summary: Hotfix: bumped min replicas, reduced cooldown, applied allowlist to model-store auth, pods recovered; follow-ups: defaults, circuit-breaker, fallback models, runbook
